headline: Beast Fang Ridge Alphas
title: Beast Fang Ridge | Three Alphas One Team | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Beast Fang Ridge hides three Alpha bosses, Glynsera, Minespine and Scorchhowl. Glynsera is Ice, so bring Fire and Earth. Minespine is Earth, so bring Water or Grass. Scorchhowl is Fire, so bring Water. A team with Fire, Water and Earth Aniimo can handle all three. Fire skills even destroy Glynsera's ice blades. Which one will you hunt first? Comment below!
description: Three Alpha bosses live in Beast Fang Ridge: Glynsera (Ice), Minespine (Earth) and Scorchhowl (Fire). A team with Fire, Water and Earth Aniimo covers all of them.
joke: Three bosses, one ridge, and zero chances to nap.
